title: Italia model manifest
description: On-device models the app downloads after install. Weights are never committed.

id.description: Stable identifier, e.g. "parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v3-int8". Also the install folder name.

kind.description: What the model does; the app picks providers by kind.

provides.description: Engine entries only: the native engine these files are a build of.

cpu.description: Engine entries only: the CPU this build needs. The app takes the first engine entry the phone meets, so list the most specific builds first.

needsEngine.description: Models run by a native engine: the engine they need, downloaded with them.

description.description: One sentence on what it is for, shown in Settings.

licence.description: SPDX licence expression of the weights and data files.

minRamBytes.description: Least total device RAM to offer the model.

rootDir.description: Folder inside the install folder that holds the model, for models shipped as an archive.

name.description: File name in the install folder.

url.description: HTTPS download URL, pinned to a revision where the host allows it.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the file; verified before the model is used.

verification.description: How sha256 and size were obtained: downloaded and hashed by us; copied from the host's published LFS metadata; or built by us with a reproducible script.

extract.description: Archive format to unpack into the install folder after verification.

available.description: False while the file is not yet uploaded to `url`; the app then offers no download. Defaults to true.
